subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which one of the following statements is incorrect with reference to megalithic burials in Andhra ?
o: Tirupati has the largest anthropomorphic burial site collection
Many numbers of cyst burials were found in Vishakhapatnam District
Sarcophagus burials are more in number in Chittoor and Anantapuramu districts
Krishna and Chittoor districts contained many numbers of dolmen burials
x: Cist burials in Andhra are concentrated in the southern and Rayalaseema/Krishna regions, not in Visakhapatnam district, so statement (2) is the incorrect one.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Statement (A) : "Gatha Saptasathi" is a collection of poems which predominantly focused on love and romantic themes.
Statement (B) : Gunadya had written Brihatkatha in Sanskrit language.
x: Hala's Gatha Saptasati is a Prakrit anthology of mostly love poems, so (A) is true. Gunadhya wrote the Brihatkatha in Paisachi Prakrit, not Sanskrit, so (B) is false.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following statements is incorrect with reference to the Ikshvakus of Vijayapuri ?
o: In their inscriptions, Ikshvakus of Vijayapuri had described themselves as the descendants of Ikshvakus of Ayodhya
Ikshvakus of Vijayapuri had matrimonial ties with Sakas/Western Satraps of Ujjain
Veerapurushadatta's reign is considered as the golden age of Buddhism in Andhra
x: The Ikshvaku inscriptions of Vijayapuri (Nagarjunakonda) do not claim descent from the Ikshvakus of Ayodhya; that link was suggested by later scholars. The other three statements are accepted facts.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: 'Janasraya' is the title of which of the following Vishnukundin rulers ?
x: Madhavavarma (II/III) of the Vishnukundins bore the title 'Janasraya'; the prosody work Janasrayi Chhandovichiti is associated with him.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Ayyana Mahadevi built the Jain temple 'Nedumba Vasati' near Vijayawada. She was the queen of
x: Ayyana Mahadevi, queen of the Eastern Chalukya founder Kubja Vishnuvardhana, built the Nedumba Vasati at Bezawada (Vijayawada), as recorded in the Musinikonda grant.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which Vishnukundin ruler had transferred the capital from Amarapuri to Denduluru ?
x: The initial key gave Madhavavarma, who is credited with moving the Vishnukundin capital to Denduluru near Eluru. APPSC's final key marks both (1) Vikramendravarma and (2) Madhavavarma as correct, so either scores.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Assertion (A) : Trade with Rome flourished in the post-Satavahana era.
Reason (R) : No ruler had issued coins with ship motif after Satavahanas.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
x: Roman trade peaked in the Satavahana period and declined after it, so (A) is false. The ship-motif coins are characteristic of the Satavahanas (Yajnasri Satakarni) and were not issued by later rulers, so (R) is taken as true.

s: extreme

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statements is/are incorrect ?
a. Billa Surgam Palaeolithic cave site is located in Anantapuramu district.
b. Belum caves located in Nandyal district is the second longest cave in India.
c. Cave sites of Kurnool and Muchatla Chintamani Gavi in A.P. are the only places in India where tools made of animal bones were found in upper palaeolithic context.
x: The Billa Surgam caves are in Kurnool (now Nandyal) district, not Anantapuramu, so only statement a is incorrect.

s: extreme
only

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following statements is not true about the Satavahanas ?
o: They were described as Andhra Brithyas in Puranas
They issued bilingual coins in Prakrit and Dravidian Script
They were patrons of Buddhism and Hinduism
They had matrimonial alliance with Kakatiyas
x: The Kakatiyas rose more than 800 years after the Satavahanas, so no marriage alliance between them was possible. The other statements are true.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statements regarding Nannaya Bhattu are correct ?
I. Nannaya Bhattu was a Telugu poet and the author of 'Andhra Mahabharatam', a Telugu retelling of the Sanskrit-language Mahabharata.
II. He is also credited with writing the Andhra Shabda Chintamani, a Sanskrit treatise on Telugu grammar.
III. Raja Raja Narendra donated Nandampudi Agrahara to Nannaya.
x: Nannaya began the Andhra Mahabharatam and is traditionally credited with the Sanskrit grammar Andhra Sabda Chintamani. The Nandampudi grant of Rajaraja Narendra was made to Narayana Bhatta, not to Nannaya, so III is wrong.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statements is/are incorrect ?
I. Saktivarma had married Kundavai, the daughter of Raja Raja Chola I.
II. Raja Raja Narendra had married Ammangaidevi, the daughter of Rajendra Chola I.
III. Rajendra Chalukya had married Madurantaki, the daughter of Rajendra Chola II.
x: Kundavai, daughter of Rajaraja Chola I, married Vimaladitya, not Saktivarma, so only statement I is incorrect.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are incorrect ?
a. Vijayaditya II is credited with the construction of 108 temples.
b. Raja Raja Narendra constructed Rajarajeswara temple at Biccavole.
c. Chalukya Bhima constructed Bhimeswara Swamy temple at Draksharama.
x: The Rajarajeswara temple at Biccavole is attributed to Gunaga Vijayaditya III's period, not to Rajaraja Narendra, so only b is incorrect. Vijayaditya II is credited with 108 Siva temples and Chalukya Bhima I with the Draksharama Bhimeswara temple.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: The architectural structure of which of the following temples exemplifies the independent style of the Chalukya-Cholas, incorporating Pallava and early Chalukya influences ?
x: The Bhimeswara temple at Draksharama shows the distinct Chalukya-Chola style that blends Pallava and early Chalukya elements.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer from the codes given below. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I (Authors) / List - II (Works)
a. Ketana - I. Markandeya Puranam
b. Marana - II. Nirvachanottara Ramayanam
c. Tikkana - III. Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam
d. Manchena - IV. Keyurabahu Charitra
x: Ketana wrote the grammar Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam, Marana the Markandeya Puranam, Tikkana the Nirvachanottara Ramayanam and Manchena the Keyurabahu Charitra.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following Chalukya-Chola Viceroys had assumed the title Sarvalokasraya, Sri Vishnuvardhana and celebrated his coronation at Jananathapura (Draksharama) ?
x: Mummadi Chola, viceroy in Vengi, took the titles Sarvalokasraya Sri Vishnuvardhana and was crowned at Jananathapura (Draksharama).

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Assertion (A) : Manumasiddhi II was reinstated on the throne by Ganapatideva.
Reason (R) : The power of Nellore Chodas was at its zenith during the reign of Manumasiddhi II.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
x: At Tikkana's request, the Kakatiya king Ganapatideva restored Manumasiddhi II to the Nellore throne, so (A) is true. The Nellore Chodas peaked under Tikka I, not Manumasiddhi II, so (R) is false.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statements regarding Kakatiyas are correct ?
I. Early Kakatiya monarchs had constructed Jain temples.
II. The influence of Chalukya temple architecture could be seen in Kakatiya temples.
III. Thousand pillared temple was built in 'Trikuta style', having three shrines, each dedicated to Rudreshwara, Vasudeva and Suryadeva.
x: Early Kakatiyas patronised Jainism, their temples follow the later Chalukya style, and the Thousand Pillar temple at Hanamkonda is a trikuta shrine to Rudreswara, Vasudeva and Surya. All three statements are correct.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Identify the wrong match.
(Author) - (Literary Work)
x: Gangadevi wrote the Sanskrit Madhura Vijayam. Marichi Parinayam was written by Mohanangi, daughter of Krishnadevaraya, so pair (1) is the wrong match.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Arrange the following Reddi rulers chronologically :
A. Kumaragiri Reddi
B. Anavema Reddi
C. Anavota Reddi
D. Pedakomati Vema Reddi
x: The Kondavidu Reddi line ran Prolaya Vema, Anavota, Anavema, Kumaragiri, then Pedakomati Vema, giving C, B, A, D.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I (Authors) / List - II (Works)
a. Pavuluri Mallana - I. Kreedabhiramam
b. Vinukonda Vallabharaya - II. Ganitasara Sangraham
c. Aryadeva - III. Chittasuddhi Prakarana
d. Dignaga - IV. Pramaana Samucchaya
x: Pavuluri Mallana translated the mathematical Ganitasara Sangraham, Vinukonda Vallabharaya wrote Kreedabhiramam, Aryadeva wrote Chittavisuddhi Prakarana and Dignaga wrote Pramana Samuccaya.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I (Inscriptions) / List - II (Rulers)
a. Sanigaram inscription - I. Mailamba
b. Anumakonda inscription - II. Ganapatideva
c. Bayyaram inscription - III. Prolaraja
d. Motupalli inscription - IV. Rudradeva
x: The Sanigaram inscription is of Prola, the Anumakonda (Thousand Pillar) inscription of Rudradeva, the Bayyaram tank inscription of Mailamba, and the Motupalli abhaya-sasana of Ganapatideva.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are incorrect ?
a. Prolaraja bore the title Arikesari.
b. Nayankara system was introduced by Prataparudra.
c. Beta II was initiated into Saivism by Rameswara Pandita of Srisailam.
x: The key treats b as the only incorrect statement: the nayankara system is usually traced to earlier Kakatiya practice and was only expanded under Prataparudra. Statements a and c are accepted.

s: by_institution

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following books was not written by Srinatha ?
x: Madana Vilasa Bhanam is a Sanskrit play by Vamana Bhatta Bana, not Srinatha. Haravilasam, Sivaratri Mahatmyam and Palnati Veera Charitra are Srinatha's works.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Sri Krishna Devaraya erected a pillar of victory to commemorate his conquest of coastal Andhra at
x: After his Kalinga campaign, Krishnadevaraya set up a victory pillar (jayastambha) at Potnuru near Simhachalam.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Statement (A) : Moturpha is a salt tax levied by British East India Company.
Statement (B) : The revenue collected by the British East India Company from the zamindars is called 'Peshcush'.
x: Moturpha was a tax on professions, trades and houses, not a salt tax, so (A) is false. The fixed tribute paid by zamindars to the Company was called peshkash, so (B) is true.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Assertion (A) : Andhra region was not greatly affected by the 1857 revolt as Andhra had no local leaders.
Reason (R) : Then reigning Nizam, Nawab Afzal-ud-Dowla adopted pro-British attitude.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
x: The key treats both as true but unrelated: the coastal Andhra districts were under the Madras Presidency, so the Nizam's pro-British stance does not explain why Andhra stayed largely quiet.

s: extreme

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following statements is incorrect ?
o: Kandukuri Veeresalingam is known as the father of renaissance movement in Andhra
"The Crescent" is an English weekly founded by Mutnuri Krishna Rao
Andhra Patrika is the first Telugu political newsweekly
Krishna Patrika was started in 1902 by Konda Venkatappaya
x: The Crescent (1844) was founded by Gazulu Lakshminarasu Chetty, not Mutnuri Krishna Rao, so (2) is incorrect. APPSC's final key also accepts (3), since the claim that Andhra Patrika was the first Telugu political newsweekly is disputed. Either (2) or (3) scores.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I / List - II
a. Kakinada riots case - I. February, 1909
b. Bipin Chandra Pal's tour in Andhra - II. July, 1907
c. Kotappa Konda riots - III. April, 1907
d. Tenali Bomb case - IV. April, 1909
x: Bipin Chandra Pal toured Andhra in April 1907, the Kakinada riots followed in July 1907, the Kotappakonda riots took place in February 1909 and the Tenali bomb case in April 1909.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Eastern Ghats in Srikakulam are called
x: The Eastern Ghats in Srikakulam district are known as the Mahendragiri hills; Papikondalu are on the Godavari and the Nallamalas and Palakondas are in Rayalaseema.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Arrange the following in chronological order :
A. Formation of the Visalandra Mahasabha
B. Dhar Commission
C. Swami Sitaram's fast
D. Formation of States Re-organization Commission
x: The Dhar Commission reported in 1948, the Visalandhra Mahasabha formed in 1949, Swami Sitaram fasted in 1951 and the States Reorganisation Commission was set up in 1953.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Assertion (A) : British ship 'Globe' under the command of Captain Hawkins arrived at Machilipatnam in 1611 A.D.
Reason (R) : Quli Qutub Shah permitted the English East India Company to establish a factory at Machilipatnam.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
x: The Globe reached Machilipatnam in 1611 under Captain Hippon, not Hawkins, so (A) is false. The Golconda Sultan (Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah) did allow the English to set up their factory there, so (R) is true.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following poets is known as "Abhinava Nannaya" ?
x: The key marks Rayaprolu Subbarao, the pioneer of the Bhava Kavitvam movement, as the poet called 'Abhinava Nannaya'.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which poet was called the "Poet of the Millennium" ?
x: Gurram Jashuva was hailed as 'Navayuga Kavi Chakravarthi' and honoured as the poet of the millennium (Sahasrabdi Kavi) in Telugu.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following statements is incorrect ?
o: September 28 marks the birth anniversary of Gurram Jashuva
He was presented the Sahitya Akademi award for his work titled 'Gabbilam' in 1964
He was appointed to the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Council as a member in 1964
He was awarded the Padma Bhushan by the Government of India
x: Jashuva won the Sahitya Akademi award in 1964 for 'Kreestu Charitra', not for 'Gabbilam', so statement (2) is incorrect.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam were known for their production of
x: Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam on the Prakasam coast were well-known salt-producing centres and saw salt satyagraha activity in 1930.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I (Andhra Maha Sabha) / List - II (Presided by)
a. 1st Session Andhra Maha Sabha - I. Mocharla Ramachandra Rao
b. 2nd Session Andhra Maha Sabha - II. Nyapati Subba Rao
c. 3rd Session Andhra Maha Sabha - III. Baiya Narasimheswara Sharma
d. 4th Session Andhra Maha Sabha - IV. Raja Rama Rayanimgar
x: The Andhra Mahasabha sessions from 1913 (Bapatla) were presided over in turn by B. N. Sarma, Nyapati Subba Rao, Panaganti Ramarayaningar and Mocharla Ramachandra Rao, which gives code (1).

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Arrange the following events chronologically :
A. Implementation of Ryotwari settlement in Madras.
B. Acquisition of Guntur by East India Company.
C. Battle of Padmanabham.
D. Abolition of Zamindari settlement in Andhra.
x: The Company acquired Guntur in 1788, the Battle of Padmanabham was fought in 1794, Ryotwari was introduced in Madras around 1820 and zamindari was abolished by the 1948 Act.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Manchikallu and Maidavolu inscriptions belong to
x: The Maidavolu plates of Sivaskandavarman and the Manchikallu inscription of Simhavarman are early Pallava Prakrit records found in Andhra.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I (Libraries) / List - II (Established in and at)
a. Vignana Chandrika Granthamandali - I. Kovvur, 1916
b. Srikrishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam - II. Hyderabad, 1906
c. Andhra Council of Research - III. Hyderabad, 1901
d. Andhra Saraswati Parishad - IV. Hyderabad, 1922
x: Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was founded in Hyderabad in 1901 and the Vignana Chandrika Granthamandali in Hyderabad in 1906; the key pairs the Andhra Council of Research with Hyderabad 1922 and the Andhra Saraswati Parishad with Kovvur 1916.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statements regarding Library Movement are correct ?
I. In 1915, the Andhra Desa Library Association started a periodical entitled 'Grandhalaya Sarvasvam' in Telugu.
II. Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao is the founder of "Andhra Patrika" established in 1908.
III. Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was established in Kovvur in 1916.
IV. In 1918, Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao started 'Boat Library Services' in West Godavari.
x: Statement III is wrong because the Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was set up in Hyderabad in 1901. The other three statements are accepted as correct.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are incorrect ?
a. Communist Party leaders worked for the Visalandhra Movement and propagated the concept of Visalandhra even before the formation of Andhra State.
b. Communists became a great force in Telangana politics.
c. Communists opposed the formation of integrated linguistic States.
x: The Communists were the main champions of Visalandhra and of linguistic states, so c is the only incorrect statement.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Who was the Chairman of the Partition Committee constituted by Madras State Government for the formation of separate State ?
x: The 1949 Partition Committee of the Madras Government was chaired by Chief Minister P. S. Kumaraswamy Raja.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Arrange the following ex-Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh chronologically and choose the correct answer :
A. Tanguturi Anjaiah
B. Damodaram Sanjivaiah
C. P. V. Narasimha Rao
D. Kasu Brahmananda Reddy
x: Sanjivaiah was Chief Minister in 1960-62, Brahmananda Reddy in 1964-71, P. V. Narasimha Rao in 1971-73 and Anjaiah in 1980-82.

s: main

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: According to the Gentlemen's Agreement, what was the ratio of Cabinet representation for Andhra and Telangana ?
x: The 1956 Gentlemen's Agreement fixed Cabinet posts at 60 per cent for Andhra and 40 per cent for Telangana.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Who was the first Telugu writer to win Jnanapith Award for the work titled "Ramayana Kalpavriksham" ?
x: Viswanatha Satyanarayana received the Jnanpith Award in 1970 for Ramayana Kalpavrukshamu, the first for a Telugu writer.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: In which year was the English East India Company established ?
x: The English East India Company received its royal charter from Elizabeth I on 31 December 1600.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which of the following Parties wanted Tirupati as the Capital of Andhra in 1953 ?
x: During the 1953 capital debate the Krishikar Lok Party, strong in Rayalaseema, pressed for Tirupati as the capital of the new Andhra State.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
List - I (Salt Satyagrahis) / List - II (Broke Salt Laws at)
a. Bulusu Sambamurty - I. Kakinada
b. Dandu Narayana Raju - II. Mattapalem
c. Kasi Viswanadham - III. Vadarevu
d. Pattabhi Sitaramayya - IV. Masulipatnam
x: In the 1930 salt satyagraha Bulusu Sambamurti led at Kakinada, Dandu Narayana Raju at Mattapalem, Kasi Viswanadham at Vadarevu and Pattabhi Sitaramayya at Machilipatnam.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Where was the French Settlement in Andhra ?
x: Yanam on the Godavari delta was a French settlement until 1954 and is now part of Puducherry.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: The inscriptions of early Satavahana kings were found in
x: The earliest Satavahana records, such as the Naneghat inscription of Naganika and the Nasik cave inscriptions, are in Maharashtra.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Justice Party Government helped the formation of which University ?
x: Andhra University was set up in 1926 under the Justice Party ministry of the Madras Presidency.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: In which book was the song 'Desamante Matti Kadoi' written ?
x: Gurajada Apparao's patriotic song 'Desamante matti kadoyi, desamante manushuloy' is part of his collection Mutyala Saralu.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match Group - A with Group - B and select the correct answer using the codes given below. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
Group - A / Group - B
a. Jainism - i. Nature Worship
b. Buddhism - ii. Ashtanga Margam
c. Saivism - iii. Triratna
d. Animism - iv. Linga
x: Triratna (three jewels) is the core of Jainism, the eightfold (ashtanga) path belongs to Buddhism, the linga is the symbol of Saivism and animism is nature worship.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match Group - A with Group - B and select the correct answer using the codes given below. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
Group - A / Group - B
a. Duggirala Gopala Krishnaiah - i. Pedanandipadu agitation
b. Parvataneni Veeraiah Choudary - ii. Najeevitha Katha
c. Ayyadevara Kaleswar Rao - iii. Rama Dandu
d. Tripuraneni Ramaswamy Choudary - iv. Kavi Raju
x: Duggirala Gopalakrishnayya organised the Rama Dandu volunteers, Parvataneni Veeraiah Chowdary led the Pedanandipadu no-tax campaign, Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao wrote the autobiography Naa Jeevitha Katha and Tripuraneni Ramaswamy was called Kaviraju.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s:
Match Group - A with Group - B and select the correct answer using the codes given below. (Common codes for English and Telugu Versions)
Group - A (Book) / Group - B (Author)
a. Japaneeyamu - i. Gurajada Appa Rao
b. Mahaprasthanam - ii. Sri Sri
c. Kanyasulkam - iii. Puchalapalli Sundarayya
d. Veyipadagalu - iv. Viswanadha Satyanarayana
v. Sriram Veerabrahmam
x: Japaneeyamu is a travelogue by Sriram Veerabrahmam, Mahaprasthanam is by Sri Sri, Kanyasulkam by Gurajada Apparao and Veyipadagalu by Viswanatha Satyanarayana.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Which religion did King Kharavela patronise ?
x: The Hathigumpha inscription shows Kharavela of Kalinga as a devoted patron of Jainism who built caves for Jain monks at Udayagiri.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Undavally caves are associated with
x: The rock-cut Undavalli caves near Vijayawada are attributed to the Vishnukundin rulers of the 4th-5th centuries.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Blue Water Policy is associated with
x: The Blue Water Policy of controlling the seas rather than land was adopted by the Portuguese viceroy Francisco de Almeida.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Who was known as the first Principal Collector of Rayalaseema ?
x: Thomas Munro was appointed the first Principal Collector of the Ceded Districts (Rayalaseema) in 1800.

x: APPSC's final key marks Krishna Patrika (1902, Machilipatnam). The key is debatable, because the missionary monthly Satyadoota (1835) is often called the first Telugu periodical.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP

s: Who was the last Asaf Jahi (Nizam) ruler ?
x: Mir Osman Ali Khan, the seventh Nizam, was the last Asaf Jahi ruler of Hyderabad State.

s: The first novel in Telugu language was
x: Veeresalingam's Rajasekhara Charitram (1878) is regarded as the first Telugu novel.

subject: Social & Cultural History of AP
s: Who was the author of "Veera Telangana Anubhavalu Gnapakalu" ?
x: The key credits Ravi Narayana Reddy, a leader of the Telangana armed struggle, with the memoir 'Veera Telangana Anubhavalu Gnapakalu'.

s: Andhra State was formed on
x: Andhra State was carved out of Madras State on 1 October 1953 with Kurnool as its capital.
